data.comment:
# Comfy FLUX 3 Image- Text to Image

Generate an image from a text prompt with FLUX 3 Image, which interprets and expands the prompt before generating it, at any of sixteen aspect ratios and up to 4K. Web and image search grounding is on by default and no input files are required. One image is output. Ideal for typography-led posters, layout-driven design work, and fast exploration of visual concepts.
 Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bfl_flux3_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: close-up of a race car driver inside a silver vintage sports car, driver wearing a red helmet with a white cross, intense focused expression, car exterior with vivid blue and red racing stripes and a solid white circular graphic on the door, viewed through the side window, intense golden hour sunlight, glowing lens flare reflecting off the glass, shallow depth of field, cinematic automotive photography, warm rich color palette, blurred abstract background Absolutely no text, no typography, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, pure imagery only.
